name: @arena/payments-service
description: Arena payments reference service (Work Order C010; issue #77; handoff §8 commercial model). Envelope-wired facade over the @arena/payments escrow ledger, bound to the C001 escalation lifecycle through injected ports (budget HOLD at creation, offer/acceptance, CAPTURE at ACCEPTED, RELEASE with the platform-fee/expert-payout split on completion, REFUND on revision/rejection/cancellation/timeout), driving the provider-neutral PaymentProviderPort, emitting escalation.payment.updated events on the A015 fabric, and hosting the explicit dispute/refund request surface. Fail-closed; cross-tenant access is typed; MoR/tax/jurisdiction stay open provider questions.
